summary: Disk enumeration has no backend cancel or singleflight: during a persistent hung drive, the 10 s client timeout abandons one backend call per 10 s and each remount adds more, so blocked threads accumulate in parallel
evidence: crates/platform/src/windows/mod.rs (lock narrowed, disks outside lock); Home.svelte REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS; re-verifier FND-0103 report
failure_scenario: A hung removable drive during a long session leaves a growing number of blocked worker threads. Blocking duration UNVERIFIED on Windows. Fix belongs in the backend (cache or singleflight for the disk list, or a per-call timeout).
resolution_note: Accepted per owner rule 2026-11-18: low and info findings are not fixed in this round; recorded in docs/status/audit.md.
